source_sheets: Only original user-supplied sheets are used at runtime

old rod.verification: Visual identification in supplied sheet: consecutive Old/Good/Super rods between independently matched Coin Case (345) and Sprayduck (349); current generic reference uses a different-generation drawing.

good rod.verification: Visual identification in supplied sheet: consecutive Old/Good/Super rods between independently matched Coin Case (345) and Sprayduck (349); current generic reference uses a different-generation drawing.

super rod.verification: Visual identification in supplied sheet: consecutive Old/Good/Super rods between independently matched Coin Case (345) and Sprayduck (349); current generic reference uses a different-generation drawing.

method: Reference images used for identity comparison only. Trim transparent bounds, normalize reference RGB to Nintendo 5-bit channels, require matching dimensions, at most two alpha differences, >=80% exact RGBA pixel agreement and low mean error; prefer the supplied main sheet. Manual rod exceptions explicitly listed. Unverified IDs omitted, never mapped by numeric game order.
fallback_policy: Current-game custom materials without an exact supplied icon retain the modern inventory terrain/material fallback. No energy-to-glasses, wool-to-scarf, or seed-to-berry aliases.
